rows.task: A runner goes up a trail at 6 km/h and comes back down the same trail at 12 km/h. What is the average speed for the round trip, in km/h?
A plane flies to a city at 400 mph and back along the same route at 600 mph. What is its average speed for the round trip, in mph?
A kayaker paddles upstream at 3 km/h and returns downstream along the same stretch at 7 km/h. Average speed for the round trip in km/h?
A tractor drives to a field at 10 mph and back at 15 mph on the same road. What is the average speed for the round trip?
A hiker walks to a hut at 4 km/h and back at 5 km/h by the same path. What is the average speed for the whole trip?
After a 20% discount, a coat costs $64. What was its original price in dollars?
After a 25% price increase, a ticket costs $45. What was the price before the increase, in dollars?
A shirt costs $50. It is discounted by 10%, and then the sale price is discounted by another 10%. What is the final price in dollars?
A price rises by 50% and then falls by 50%. By what percent is the final price lower than the original?
Pipe A fills a tank in 3 hours and pipe B fills it in 6 hours. Working together, how many hours do they take to fill it?
Alice paints a fence in 4 hours and Bob paints it in 12 hours. How many hours do they take working together?
A student scores 70 on a test worth 40% of the grade and 90 on a test worth 60% of the grade. What is the weighted average score?

A $120 dinner gets 8% sales tax added and is then split evenly among 5 friends. How much does each friend pay, in dollars?
A $250 order is 20% off and then 6% sales tax is added. What is the final total in dollars?
A car travels 150 miles in 2.5 hours, then 90 miles in 1.5 hours. What is its average speed for the whole journey, in mph?
A population of 2000 grows by 10% each year. What is the population after 2 years?
$1000 earns 5% interest compounded annually. How many dollars is it worth after 3 years? Round to the cent.
A recipe for 4 people uses 300 g of flour. How many grams of flour are needed for 10 people?
A 12% tip is added to a $75 bill, and the total is split evenly among 3 people. How much does each person pay, in dollars?
A courier bikes to the warehouse at 15 km/h and back along the same road at 10 km/h. What is the average speed for the round trip, in km/h?
A bus goes to the airport at 50 mph and returns on the same route at 75 mph. What is its average speed for the round trip, in mph?
A dog runs to the end of the beach at 18 km/h and trots back at 9 km/h. What is its average speed for the round trip?
A boat goes upriver at 6 knots and comes back downriver the same distance at 14 knots. What is the average speed for the round trip?
A van drives to a market at 35 mph and back at 70 mph by the same road. What is the average speed for the whole trip?

After a 10% price increase, a meal costs $33. What was the price before the increase, in dollars?

A stock rises by 20% and then falls by 20%. By what percent is the final value lower than the original?

Sam cleans a house in 5 hours and Kim cleans it in 20 hours. How many hours do they take working together?
A course grade is 30% homework and 70% exam. Homework is 90 and the exam is 60. What is the final grade?
4 liters of juice cost $3 per liter and 6 liters cost $2 per liter. What is the average price per liter of all the juice, in dollars?
A $90 lunch gets 10% sales tax added and is then split evenly among 3 friends. How much does each friend pay, in dollars?
A $400 TV is 15% off and then 5% sales tax is added. What is the final total in dollars?
